purpose: Prevent metadata wrappers or re-hosted views of the same acoustic origin from inflating source-diversity credit.

fsd50k-1.0.note: FSD50K clips originate from Freesound; direct Freesound acquisition of the same sound is not a second source family.

echo-opengameart-rubberduck-cc0-v1.note: The canonical OpenGameArt submission identifies rubberduck as creator of the pack. The pinned GitHub mirror is byte transport only and never receives separate source-family credit.

echo-opengameart-till-behrend-glass-v1.note: The canonical OpenGameArt page names Till Behrend as author and states the upload was made with permission from the author. OpenGameArt hosting is publication/byte transport context, not the acoustic-origin family identity.

echo-soundbible-mike-koenig-tire-v1.note: All three OpenGameArt archive members derive from Mike Koenig's single SoundBible Tires Squealing recording family. OpenGameArt is transport/derivative-publication evidence only and receives no second diversity credit.

rules: Source diversity is counted by underlying acoustic-origin family, not wrapper/dataset name.
The same SHA-256 or same upstream sound identity can never receive multiple source-family credits.
Synthetic/reference-only sources never receive independent real-source credit.
A mirror/host receives no source-family credit when the canonical creator/origin is already known.
Derived edits from one proven acoustic origin remain one family and one recording group unless stronger independent-origin evidence exists.
When a stronger recording/session relationship becomes known, grouping must be upgraded and downstream evidence rerun.
